thesis: The bull case carried the debate because Gamuda combines fresh data-centre awards, a large replenished order book, and positive earnings-revision momentum with a still-constructive medium-term price structure. The buy view is conditional on execution and cash conversion; the premium multiple and negative free cash flow prevent a high-confidence ruling.
strongest_counterexample: A large order book can destroy value if project costs, financing, delays, or working-capital requirements consume the expected margin; RM883.6m of negative free cash flow and only 6.28% net margin show that this is not a theoretical risk.
invalidation_conditions: Two consecutive reporting periods show negative free cash flow without a credible milestone-collection explanation, alongside declining operating margin.
Material delays, cancellations, or margin deterioration affect the newly reported data-centre or major infrastructure awards.
Price breaks below the observed RM4.30 support area and SMA-200 on usable volume after the data-quality limitation is resolved.
evidence_gaps: Contract-level margin, milestone timing, backlog ageing, and cash-collection data.
A clean dated volume series and a valid 52-week low from the completed-close input.
Net USD/MYR sensitivity of overseas projects, imported materials, and financing.
decisive_factors: Fresh data-centre awards and record order-book evidence provide more than a purely aspirational growth narrative.
The stock remains above SMA-50 and SMA-200 despite short-term momentum softening.
The negative FCF and premium valuation were treated as conditions to monitor, not proof that the growth thesis is broken.
